description: TopicLift Editorial Copilot gives publishers a read-only conversational interface to their TopicLift workspace. Ask about realtime and historical traffic, top and declining articles, Google Search, Google Discover, Google News, aggregate search queries, and evidence-backed editorial opportunities. Recommendations include editorial themes, supporting metrics, confidence, and proposed titles or angles. The integration is scoped to the authenticated TopicLift workspace and cannot edit articles, WordPress, settings, or reports.

defaultPrompt: How did Google Discover perform for my site over the last 28 days? Highlight the most relevant articles and editorial themes.
Compare my site’s total traffic over the last 28 days with the previous period. Explain the main changes and traffic sources.
Based on recent Search and Discover data, what should I publish next? Suggest editorial themes, titles, angles and metrics.
